exposure: night sleep (total night sleep difficulties, settling, night waking, co-sleeping)
parental bedtime practices (total parental bedtime practices, active physical comforting, encouraging autonomy, leaving to cry)
cohort: The study included 38 late talkers, comprising 19 low-risk preterm and 19 full-term children, observed from 31 to 37 months of age.
finding: Improvements in parental practices of encouraging autonomy were significantly associated with increased sentence production in late talkers from 31 to 37 months.
